purpose: Define independent camera objects with their own transforms, zoom, interaction gains and projection settings.
invariants: Each camera has a stable id and name.
Each camera owns its complete viewer camera state; camera settings are not global shared state.
Each camera has a normal position/rotation/scale transform.
Switching cameras MUST restore the selected camera's own transform, zoom, gains and advanced projection settings.
Camera state is viewer/presentation state and MUST NOT alter CW semantics, source evidence or projection semantics.
Camera cycling wraps in both directions.
Bookmarks MAY reference cameras but a camera is not a bookmark.

advanced.fov: Perspective field of view in degrees.
advanced.scale: Full camera transform scale remains editable but may be presented under Advanced because it is rarely adjusted.

ui.rule: The normal camera workflow must expose the frequently adjusted controls without requiring Advanced to be open.
